purpose: README hero recording: one real Oh My Pi session against the released v0.14.0 RTX 5090 runtime, including a server restart mid-session. Product claims are bound by the release receipts, not by this clip.

client.distribution: unmodified upstream Oh My Pi release binary

configuration.models_yml: examples/manual-tunnel/models.fragment.yml installed verbatim (provider ninfer-beta, model q38-ninfer, compat.statefulResponses true)
configuration.config_yml: examples/manual-tunnel/fail-closed.yml installed verbatim (retries and model fallback off, update check off, maxInFlightRequests)
configuration.key: the appliance bearer key installed as ninfer-beta.key (mode 600) and read through the fragment's !cat value
configuration.environment: isolated neutral HOME outside any user account; PATH limited to the demo bin directory and the system directories; OMP_SKIP_SETUP=1 (skips the first-run wizard); TERM=xterm-256color COLORTERM=truecolor
display_only_adaptations: --hide-thinking hides reasoning blocks in the TUI; the model's reasoning ran unchanged
--thinking low selects the fragment's lowest effort level

runtime.host: the maintainer's RTX 5090 appliance (Windows 11, Docker Desktop/WSL2), promoted to omp-ninfer v0.14.0 earlier the same day

route.shape: Mac loopback 127.0.0.1:18089 -> OpenSSH local forward -> appliance host loopback -> Docker published port -> bearer-authenticated ninfer-serve
route.capture_adaptation: The maintainer's production container keeps the released profile, configuration, image, server binary and model identity but publishes its port on the Windows host instead of the product profile's loopback-only :18089 and runs with restart=unless-stopped; the Mac side used the product's documented loopback port through the tunnel. Engine bytes, configuration, model and authentication were the released identity throughout.
route.restart_helper: ninfer-restart: a demo shell helper outside the project directory that runs `docker restart --timeout 60` on the inference host over SSH, polls /health through the tunnel, then prints one line from the authenticated /v1/ninfer/status response (max_context and the engine source prefix). Its two output lines are the helper's own text; the SSH destination comes from an environment variable and never appears on screen.

session.project: scratch git repository with lru.py (an OrderedDict LRU cache whose get() does not refresh recency) and test_lru.py (three unittest cases, one failing); synthetic, content-safe

turns.input: One test in test_lru.py fails: the cache evicts the wrong entry. Find the bug in lru.py, fix it, and run the tests.
turns.observed: read both files, explained the bug, one-line edit at lru.py:16 (self._items.move_to_end(key)), ran python3 -m unittest -v: 3/3 ok, summarized Bug and Fix
ninfer-serve container restarted on the appliance; helper reported serving again after 36 s

turns.input: In one sentence: why did only the third test catch it?
turns.observed: answered in context after the restart (first two tests never rely on a get refreshing recency before eviction)

session.context_usage_at_end: 8% of 131,072 tokens in the OMP status line
session.driver: keystrokes were sent by a pty driver at roughly 36 characters per second with jitter; no text was pasted

restart.command: docker restart --timeout 60 <container> over SSH; graceful stop (SIGTERM with a 60 s grace) then start of the same container id
restart.fleet_custody: owner fleet admission was paused before the take, the same container id was reconciled and admission resumed after it (phase Fleet, no blockers)

continuation_after_restart.source: GET /v1/ninfer/status over the tunnel after the recording; counters are since the restarted process started
continuation_after_restart.reading: The follow-up after the restart reused 10,375 retained prompt tokens over the session's own continuation endpoint and computed 155 new prefill tokens: the session state flushed by the graceful stop was restored from the release-isolated checkpoint store. The session was below the 32,768-token automatic checkpoint gate, so without a graceful stop the same turn would have been replayed from OMP's transcript.

unavailable_fields.cache.host_kv.capacity_bytes: unified Host pool has no independently reserved KV capacity
unavailable_fields.cache.host_state.capacity: unified Host pool has no independently reserved State capacity
unavailable_fields.cache.last_materialization_predicted_nan: fork whole-materialization planner has no master equivalent
unavailable_fields.cache.private_catalog.capacity: master catalog is resource-budgeted, not a fixed private-slot count
unavailable_fields.cache.private_evictions: fork pressure-policy counters have no equivalent master counter
unavailable_fields.cache.shared_catalog.active_references: master has no native shared-reader-count ledger
unavailable_fields.cache.shared_catalog.capacity: master catalog is resource-budgeted, not a fixed shared-slot count
unavailable_fields.cache.shared_evictions: fork pressure-policy counters have no equivalent master counter

redaction.verified_over: both public cast byte streams, including playback headers and decoded event text; .cast files are included in the public-text release verifier
redaction.note: Capture-only command and environment header fields were removed in the v0.15.1 documentation scrub. The synthetic scratch-home prefix in both public cast streams is normalized to /demo-home; event order and timing are unchanged. GIF, MP4 and poster remain the original renders of the synthetic project, not a new capture.

render_cast_derivation.event_payloads: byte-identical and in the same order; only two timing changes

restart_wait_compression.note: the interval from the helper's first output line to its 'serving again' line, during which the TUI showed only a running indicator

tail_trim.note: the /exit keystrokes and shutdown after the final answer are dropped; the last kept event is the final answer render

mp4.note: one row of ground color padded for an even height
